run_hg_export_cli: run the fairseq2 Hugging Face export CLI to convert a model to Hugging Face format
run_export_with_checkpoint_dir: run the hg_export CLI with a custom checkpoint directory to export a local model
run_export_with_extra_asset: run the hg_export CLI with an extra asset card path to export a custom model
run_export_to_s3: run the hg_export CLI to export a fairseq2 model directly to an S3 bucket URI
run_export_no_rich: run the hg_export CLI with rich text output disabled for plain logging
